estimand: target local share of valid party votes conditional on source local/national party shares and supplied target national support

construction.closure: divide all target-group unnormalized values by their joint sum

benchmark: flat supplied target national party vector in every electorate
nationalReconciliation: not imposed; observed target valid-party counts are oracle evaluation weights for diagnostic only
primarySample: all held general contests in fixed 213-row frame, with full-population construction including Maori and cancelled Port Waikato party ballot
mae: 100*equal-electorate mean of within-electorate equal-target-category absolute error
rmse: 100*sqrt(equal-electorate mean of within-electorate equal-target-category squared error)
bias: 100*equal-electorate mean predicted minus actual within target category
